UPDATE risk
         SET title = $5, description = $6, likelihood = $7, impact = $8, mitigation = $9,
             owner_user_id = $10, workstream_id = $11, status = $12, version = version + 1, updated_at = $13
         WHERE organization_id = $1 AND event_id = $2 AND id = $3 AND version = $4
         RETURNING version
